Basic text-to-speech generation

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.createSpeechRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"Hello, world!\",\"model\":\"tts-1\",\"voice\":\"alloy\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.speech(req: _req)
print(result)
```
